answer_4.quote: We conducted a comparison between our human-centric method GradPath and the algorithmic explanation method Gradient Rollback (GR) to investigate whether GradPath can offer more plausible explanations.
answer_4.guideline: We ask the following questions to each tester: • Is the predicted triple correct? (Two scales, see below) • How confident is the assessment? (Scale: 5 point Likert) • Is an explanation helpful? (Scale: yes and no)
criteria: Number of helpful explanations for a triple
Time cost for a tester to assess a prediction
